s01.text: Did you know that a gentle breeze can help plants grow stronger?

s03.text: One grows in a completely windless environment, while the other experiences a gentle breeze every day.

s04.text: Surprisingly, the second tree may develop a stronger structure!

s05.text: When plants sway in the wind, they sense mechanical stimulation.

s06.text: This triggers a fascinating biological response called Thigmomorphogenesis.

s07.text: As a result, plants may develop shorter, thicker stems and stronger supporting tissues, helping them withstand mechanical stress.

s08.text: Even their roots can adjust their growth and development in response to changing environmental conditions.

s09.text: It's almost as if nature is giving plants a gentle workout!

s10.text: But remember, too much wind can damage plants rather than strengthen them.

s11.text: Sometimes, a little movement is exactly what helps a plant become more resilient.

s12.text: Nature has its own way of building strength!

s13.text: Follow Art of Agriculture for more amazing secrets of the plant world.
